holdout_lon.note: these longitude columns are held out of TRAINING in both stages, so each scope aggregate here is a blend of trained and never-trained pixels; the *_trainlon / *_holdlon splits beside every scope are the unblended numbers, and *_trainlon is the one that answers 'what did the model learn'. The blend is deflationary -- an untrained pixel scores low -- so a parent aggregate is a lower bound on its own _trainlon.

inputs.doc: E-043d2 · RE-ROLLS the E-032 clean xl144 seed pair, both already published with NO training of any kind, to read the new *_trainlon / *_holdlon split (ml/rollout_spatial.py:706-707, landed in 92a88e5) beside every scope — gate, corridor, window, section — so a published corridor AUC can be decomposed into the ~75% of pixels the head trained on and the ~25% it never saw · params 40.693M codec + 211.4M per head · stage sroll (eval-only; NOTHING trains, steps below are the checkpoint's own count) · data family3_na025 (C 39, T 516) · arch codec 576x10, 8 heads, d_dec 768, d_z 64, patch 3; heads 1024x16, stencil 145, ring spiral:111,4444,0.71,0.5 · steps x batch 60,000 x 512 (= f3_anchor41M's recorded step count, zero training steps) · resume !run-62,run-63 (f3_anchor41M, frozen). HEADS: e017_u1_s0 — the VALIDATION GATE, which must reproduce horizon_auc 0.643 within GATE_TOL 0.0101 or the run is void — plus e032xl_u1_s0 and e032xl_u1_s1 — the FINAL 200k heads, not the e032xlx600/60000/120000 milestone assets — whose rolled corridor AUCs are 0.68067 and 0.67558 as scored by #356. SECOND of two dispatches pinned to gpu-box-31479844 and queued behind E-043d1: gate + 4 heads at ~3 h/head exceeds #413's measured 700-minute job, so the wave splits, each half re-rolling the gate. This pair is also arm E-043b's control, which is why its trainlon decomposition is wanted in the same wave as arm B's dispatch. HYPOTHESIS: the published aggregates are deflationary blends, so every scope's _trainlon exceeds its parent and _holdlon falls far below it (in-block h=6 skill ~0.23 against ~0.86 outside). FALSIFIER: if _trainlon and _holdlon sit inside each other's noise, the -45..-25 block is not a hole the roll can see and the reporting defect 92a88e5 fixes was cosmetic. NOT A REPLICATE (§3b): re-rolling a fixed checkpoint through a fixed protocol measures the PROTOCOL — these are an integrity check and a decomposition, never a seed spread, and none of them may be entered in the spread column.
